# SaaS platform partners

## Grow your embedded payments and financial services offering with expert guidance, tailored resources, and incentives.

SaaS platforms embed payments and financial services directly into their platform. This includes offering features like Checkout, Invoicing, and lending within their SaaS solution, opening up new revenue opportunities by offering additional features for their businesses. SaaS platforms can join the Stripe Partner Ecosystem at two tiers: Stripe Partner and Premier Partner. Stripe Partners can access on-demand resources and revenue sharing, while Premier Partners get additional advisory services, enhanced support, and market development funds (MDF).

## Stripe Partner and Premier Partner requirements

Stripe Partners need to meet the following SaaS platform technical and business requirements:

- Use [Stripe Connect](https://stripe.com/connect) to access Stripe accounts and data.
- Process at least 1 million USD in payment volume annually.
- Use [Payment Intents](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents).
- Set up Stripe [webhook](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks) endpoints for [Connect events](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/webhooks).
- Create a landing page that describes your Stripe integration.
- Use Checkout Sessions.
- Use Stripe [Checkout](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout) or [Payment Element](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-element) to tokenize payment information.
- Use [idempotency keys](https://docs.stripe.com/error-low-level#idempotency).

## Program benefit details

Explore each program benefit.

### Stripe Connect revenue sharing program

Partners in the SaaS platform track using Stripe Connect are eligible for the revenue sharing program, which enables your company to grow as your customers expand with Stripe.

## Build

Set the right foundations with essential resources for creating a product roadmap, organizing teams, developing a monetization strategy, and executing migrations.

### Design guides

Access guides to organize effective payments teams, develop a successful revenue model, and ensure a smooth rollout of your embedded payments and financial services solutions.

### Transaction cost management guides

Access expert advice for managing your transaction costs by optimizing network costs, understanding authorization rates, and detecting fraud. Understand your network costs structure and optimizations for cost+ pricing. Learn about card authorization rates and network declines. Develop your fraud management strategy by accessing best practices to detect and prevent fraud, understanding fintech fraud, and managing fraudulent transactions.

### Product-specific launch recommendations

Assess your readiness to launch new embedded solutions with recommendations to guide your technical, operational, and go-to-market strategies.

## Market

Grow faster with product marketing resources, prebuilt campaigns, and marketing insights that help drive demand for your solutions. Premier partners are also eligible for tailored advisory services, market development funds, and joint case studies.

### Segmentation and joint value proposition guidance

Identify your target segments for your embedded payments and financial services within your base. Develop your ideal customer profile and a joint value proposition to inform your messaging strategy.

### Templates and other resources

Market with Stripe using our campaigns in a box and product marketing toolkits. Stripe provides resources for partners such as messaging frameworks, templated blogs, emails, and social content that you can customize to launch integrated campaigns that drive demand.

### Sponsorship and speaking opportunities

We might invite select partners to participate in speaking opportunities at Stripe events to increase their visibility among Stripe sellers and customers.

### Stripe Partner badge and co-branding guidelines

Partners can download the Stripe Partner badge or Stripe Premier Partner badge from the partner portal. Use these badges externally to promote your partnership and strengthen your listing in the partner directory. Stripe also provides co-branding guidelines.

### Directory listing

The Stripe partner directory listing provides Stripe partners with the opportunity to promote their company and relationship with Stripe. The company details page can help drive leads and build awareness of their solutions or services.

### Tailored marketing advisory workshops

Premier Partners are eligible to receive marketing advisory with the Stripe marketing team to discuss insights, best practices, and receive recommendations about how to improve their acquisition, activation, and lifecycle marketing strategies. Partners can request market development funds (MDF) to cover the cost of marketing activities recommended from the workshop.

### Request market development funds (MDF)

Premier Partners can request MDF to help fund the cost of co-marketing activities that generate demand for their embedded payments and financial services. Examples of eligible activities include integrated marketing campaigns, paid media, and digital and in-person customer-facing events.

### Joint customer case studies and social media highlights

We might invite Premier Partners to participate in a joint case study to showcase how we worked together to solve a user’s business challenge. Reach out to your account executive if you have a story you’d like to nominate for consideration. Premier Partners are eligible to be featured across Stripe social media channels, including our LinkedIn page, and have their message amplified to Stripe businesses and community.

## Sell

Help deals close faster with sales enablement resources and co-selling support.

### Deal registration

Partners can submit a referral to Stripe or they can co-sell with Stripe to close opportunities. You can use three channels for deal registration: submit referrals through the partner portal, bulk upload files with up to 50 leads, or register deals through an ungated lead form. Partners can also track the progress of a deal through the partner portal.

### Sales enablement and payments education for sellers

Stripe partners can access sales materials, including pitch decks, discovery guides, and objection-handling guidance, to help increase conversion with prospective customers.

## Scale

Optimize user experiences and manage costs as you expand and fuel new growth with additional solutions across more markets.

### Guides for optimizing support and risk experiences

Review guides from Stripe experts to help improve your user experiences across verifications, support operations, and risk management. Address the most common support questions and access guides to developing a risk management strategy centered on your target audience.

### Reactive support

Premier Partners can access a new service level designed to provide priority, context-aware support and the fastest reactive support that Stripe offers.

### Payments and support optimization workshops

Premier Partners can receive periodic proactive engagements through a scaled technical account manager to review supportability and technical health and a scaled customer success manager to review your payments health, fraud rates, and authorization rates.
